newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker in line for oil ship deal - sources.
newsitem.headline: Aker in line for oil ship deal - sources.

text.p: Aker Maritime ASA is likely be awarded the contract to build the topside for the Ramform design floating production, storage and offloading system (FPSO) for Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS), industry sources said on Wednesday.
PGS announced on Wednesday it had been awarded a $350 million contract to build and operate the FPSO for U.S. oil company Conoco's Banff oilfield in the British sector of the North Sea.
The sources said PGS had worked closely with Aker Maritime on the contract, which is thought to be worth almost one billion crowns.
"A final contract has not been signed," Morten Lunde, Finance Director in PGS, told Reuters.
